Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker/owner supplied address and data (backdoor).

Owner-only batch distribution with unchecked multiplication of _value*_tos.length and unchecked balance subtraction.

Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256/create2.
Payable constructor minting supply to msg.sender, setting owner and max allowance to the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys and balance keys.
Low-level delegatecall executed in storage context of this contract, gated only by msg.sender==owner.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (0.5.x checked only on underflow, custom token semantics).
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition enabling supply inflation without mint tracking.
uint total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication that can wrap around.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction after wrapped total computation.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender to _from and uses it as the allowance holder key.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller-controlled address.
delegate() gate require(msg.sender==owner) determines whether arbitrary delegatecall executes.
init() requires msg.sender==owner before writing sale parameters.
batchSend() requires msg.sender==owner before draining balances.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender==owner before whitelisting an exempt address.
Constructor stores msg.sender as owner and as the initial supply holder.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom().
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances.
ensure falls back to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure computes the pair address via pairFor().
delegate() executes a low-level delegatecall with caller-supplied target and calldata.
The bytes parameter b is used directly as delegatecall calldata.
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from allowance without SafeMath.
transferFrom adds the amount to the recipient balance without SafeMath.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend subtracts the computed total from the sender balance without SafeMath.
The unchecked local total flows into the unchecked balance subtraction.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for source and destination.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
ensure whitelists the owner address.
ensure whitelists the constant UNI router address.
ensure whitelists tradeAddress, bypassing all sale restrictions.
ensure whitelists any address flagged in canSale.
condition compares the value against _minSale.
condition compares the value against _maxSale.
condition compares the per-address sale count against _saleNum.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale limit.
init writes _minSale derived from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale derived from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
delegate checks the caller against the stored owner.
init checks the caller against the stored owner.
batchSend checks the caller against the stored owner.
setTradeAddress checks the caller against the stored owner.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supply parameter.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
Constructor sets an unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
